subject: Culture
title: The Spice Trade
description: Learn The Spice Trade in one minute.

hook.text: Columbus wasn't looking for America. He was looking for black pepper.

buildup.text: Spices were worth more than gold in medieval Europe. Pepper, cinnamon, and cloves drove exploration.

discovery.text: The Portuguese conquered Goa, the Dutch seized the Spice Islands, and the British took India—all for flavor.

twist.text: Once refrigeration appeared, spices lost their preservation role. But empires had already been built.

climax.text: The spice trade reshaped every continent's borders, languages, and cuisines forever.

punchline.text: Empires rose and fell for what's now in your spice rack.

quiz.question: What was Columbus primarily seeking when he sailed west in 1492?
